reuse.reason: Complete marked fork of the pinned official locale plugin. The built-in zh display label changes to 简体中文. A minimal Host-data seam installs the public site-title LocaleFace adapter instead of the raw locale service; internal locale IDs, persistence, routing, language row components and dictionaries stay official. The unchanged official AppFrame and DocumentTitle remain the only browser-title implementation.
gaps: User-authorized display-name deviation: zh is displayed as 简体中文 while the internal id and the /zh-CN route stay official.

User-approved global site identity: the renderer common/brand.localBuild seat reads the same published localized titles as the site SEO document (active language, then English, then site name). Before the public title snapshot arrives it delegates to official translation. The adapter merges locale/site revisions and releases both subscriptions on disposal; unrelated keys and namespaces remain untouched. This is Host data only, with no document.title mutation, duplicate dictionary registration or second renderer locale installation.
